title: Two-bar plane truss: joint displacement under a horizontal load

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Pin-jointed plane truss in the x-y plane (global Y vertical): members of type 'truss'; the out-of-plane translation of every joint is held by a support (it has no stiffness in a plane truss). Joints (m): b (0, 0), a (6, 4), c (9, 0) from the printed dimensions 6 m, 3 m, 4 m; b and c pinned. Bars ab A = 6000 mm^2, ac A = 8000 mm^2, E = 200,000 MPa. Load 500 kN along +x at a. First order.
